import json, os, re, shutil, time
from pathlib import Path

settings_path = Path(os.path.expanduser(r"~/.codex-session-delete/settings.json"))
config_path = Path(os.path.expanduser(r"~/.codex/config.toml"))
auth_path = Path(os.path.expanduser(r"~/.codex/auth.json"))

# backup
ts = time.strftime("%Y%m%d-%H%M%S")
bak = settings_path.with_suffix(f".json.bak-fix-url-{ts}")
shutil.copy2(settings_path, bak)
print(f"backup: {bak}")

data = json.loads(settings_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
WRONG = "https://ai.hctopup.com/v1"
RIGHT = "https://api.tangguo.xin/v1"
KEY = "sk-YOUR_SECRET"

# Fix top-level relay base
if data.get("relayBaseUrl") == WRONG:
    data["relayBaseUrl"] = RIGHT
    print("fixed relayBaseUrl")

# Fix active One-API profile
fixed_profiles = 0
for p in data.get("relayProfiles", []):
    if p.get("id") == "ccs-one-api-1782980572222" or (
        p.get("name", "").startswith("One-API") and KEY in (p.get("authContents") or "")
    ):
        before = p.get("upstreamBaseUrl")
        p["upstreamBaseUrl"] = RIGHT
        if p.get("configContents"):
            p["configContents"] = p["configContents"].replace(WRONG, RIGHT)
        # normalize auth
        p["authContents"] = json.dumps({"OPENAI_API_KEY": KEY}, indent=2)
        print(f"fixed profile {p.get('id')} upstream {before} -> {RIGHT}")
        fixed_profiles += 1

if fixed_profiles == 0:
    print("WARNING: no One-API profile matched")

# Prefer active relay stay on one-api
data["activeRelayId"] = "ccs-one-api-1782980572222"

settings_path.write_text(json.dumps(data, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
print("wrote settings.json")

# Fix live config.toml if needed
cfg = config_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
if WRONG in cfg:
    config_path.write_text(cfg.replace(WRONG, RIGHT), encoding="utf-8")
    print("fixed config.toml base_url")
else:
    # ensure tangguo present
    m = re.search(r'base_url\s*=\s*"(.*?)"', cfg)
    print(f"config.toml base_url currently: {m.group(1) if m else 'NOT FOUND'}")

# Ensure auth.json
auth_path.write_text(json.dumps({"OPENAI_API_KEY": KEY}, indent=4) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
print("wrote auth.json")

# Verify
cfg2 = config_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
print("verify config has hctopup:", WRONG in cfg2)
print("verify config has tangguo:", RIGHT in cfg2)
data2 = json.loads(settings_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
print("verify relayBaseUrl:", data2.get("relayBaseUrl"))
for p in data2["relayProfiles"]:
    if p["id"] == "ccs-one-api-1782980572222":
        print("verify one-api upstream:", p["upstreamBaseUrl"])
        print("verify one-api config has hctopup:", WRONG in (p.get("configContents") or ""))
        print("verify one-api config has tangguo:", RIGHT in (p.get("configContents") or ""))

content.text:
**结论：不是 Codex 坏了，是「地址」和「Key」配错了。**

## 原因

你现在用的 One-API Key（`sk-84247a938...`）只在 **`https://api.tangguo.xin/v1`** 有效。  
但 Codex++ 的活跃中转 `One-API（ccswitch）` 把请求发到了 **`https://ai.hctopup.com/v1`**。

实测结果：

| 地址 | 结果 |
|------|------|
| `api.tangguo.xin` + 当前 Key | **200**（正常） |
| `ai.hctopup.com` + 当前 Key | **401 INVALID_API_KEY**（就是你看到的报错） |

所以 ccswitch / Codex++「切换到 One-API」只改了一半：Key 对了，Base URL 却被写成了 HCAI 的 `hctopup`。

## 已修复

已改好这些文件：

1. `~/.codex-session-delete/settings.json`  
   - `relayBaseUrl` → `https://api.tangguo.xin/v1`  
   - One-API 中转的 `upstreamBaseUrl` / `configContents` 一并改回 tangguo  
2. 确认 `~/.codex/config.toml` 已是 `base_url = "https://api.tangguo.xin/v1"`  
3. 重写了 `~/.codex/auth.json`（仍用同一把有效 Key）

## 你需要做的

**完全退出并重启 Codex**（当前进程还在跑，可能仍缓存旧 URL）。重启后再发一条消息即可。

若重启后仍报 401，到 CC Switch 里对 Codex 再点一次切换到 **One-API**，确认地址是 `api.tangguo.xin`，不要再混用 `ai.hctopup.com`。

        print("modelList=", repr(p["modelList"]))
